rules: Historical migration filenames are immutable and must not be renamed after deployment.
Intent and historical naming clarifications must be recorded in this manifest.
Validation must fail if a SQL migration file exists without a manifest entry, or vice versa.

migrations.intent: Create foundational runs and audit_events tables.
Add run lifecycle status/timestamp columns and status constraint.
Add backtest/replay schema including md_bars and run_events.
Add md_quality_reports ingest quality table and index.
Add outbox claim tracking columns for dispatcher claim-lock semantics.
Add singleton sys_arm_state table for fail-closed persisted arm state.
Add broker_order_map persistence for crash-safe cancel/replace recovery.
Add reconcile checkpoint watermark persistence.
Add/strengthen DB constraints enforcing allowed state values and relationships.
Add idempotency constraints for outbox/inbox safety.
Add inbox applied tracking column(s) for atomic apply semantics.
Remove implicit default from reconcile checkpoint timestamp field(s).
Add/repair FK relationship between broker mapping and outbox rows.
Add consistency checks around outbox claim metadata/state transitions.
Scope inbox dedupe uniqueness to run identity.
Add explicit DISPATCHING outbox state support.
Expand arm-state disarm reasons to include recovery quarantine semantics.
Held alternative migration for global broker_fill_id uniqueness; not part of deployed chain.
Create runtime_leader_lease, runtime_control_state, and runtime_restart_requests tables.
migrations.filename_note: Filename mentions outbox dispatching, but deployed content establishes runtime leader/control/restart tables. Name is preserved for migration-history safety.

migrations.intent: Add durable broker_event_cursor table for restart-safe event consumption.
Add explicit AMBIGUOUS outbox status and supporting constraints.
Add explicit broker identity/lineage columns on inbox rows.
Add durable operator truth tables for risk block and reconcile status.
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraints to include operator/runtime lease and deadman disarm reasons already used by durable control surfaces.
Add unique economic fill dedupe on (run_id, broker_fill_id) while preserving transport-message dedupe.
Add missing enriched inbox identity columns used by current insert contract and backfill defaults for existing rows.
Add durable risk_denial_events table for persisted risk denial event history.
Add durable sys_strategy_suppressions table for restart-safe strategy suppression persistence (CC-02).
Add fill_quality_telemetry table for durable, per-fill execution quality telemetry (TV-EXEC-01): actual price, timing, slippage, and provenance per fill event.
Add sys_strategy_registry table as the authoritative durable registry of known strategies (CC-01A): canonical identity, display name, enabled state, kind, and timestamps.
Expand runs.mode CHECK constraint to include 'live-shadow' alongside 'PAPER', 'LIVE', 'BACKTEST'.
Add sys_restart_intent multi-row log table for durable restart intent / restart provenance (CC-03B): mode transition verdict, initiated_by, lifecycle status, caller-injected timestamps.

Add sys_autonomous_session_events table for durable autonomous paper supervisor history/evidence (AUTON-PAPER-02): restart-safe recovery attempts/results, refusals, stop outcomes, and operator-reviewable soak evidence.
Add durable alert acknowledgment persistence for operator-facing alert triage truth.
Add durable incidents table and linkage support for operator incident tracking truth.
Add durable OMS order lifecycle event history for authoritative cancel/replace/fill/reject lineage.
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraint to include InboundContinuityUnproven, enabling durable halt/disarm when Alpaca WS inbound continuity is cold-start unproven or gap-detected (EXEC-CONT-01).
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraint to include CancelTargetMissing, enabling durable halt/disarm when a cancel outbox row targets an order absent from the live OMS map (EXEC-CANCEL-01).

Add dispatch_attempt_count, next_dispatch_after_utc, last_dispatch_error to oms_outbox for bounded, backoff-gated, restart-safe retryable dispatch (EXEC-RETRY-01). Claim filter gates on next_dispatch_after_utc so backed-off rows are invisible to the dispatcher until their window expires.

Add sys_broker_position_baseline singleton table for durable operator-adopted broker position baseline at paper startup (sentinel_id=1 pattern matching sys_arm_state). No DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() — callers supply all fields.

MIGRATION-0040-BACKFILL-DUP-FILLS-01: deterministic historical cleanup of duplicate event_kind='fill' rows (WS+REST dual delivery, Pattern A applied; REST reingestion, Pattern B unapplied) followed by unique partial index uq_inbox_run_order_single_fill enforcing at most one final fill per (run_id, internal_order_id). Canonical keep rule: applied over unapplied, broker_fill_id present over null, earliest applied_at_utc, earliest received_at_utc, lowest inbox_id.

DATA-INGEST-JOB-PERSISTENCE-01: add sys_ingest_jobs durable daemon ingest job history for DB-backed job list/status restart survival. Caller supplies all timestamps; no provider secrets or raw provider payloads are stored.

DATA-PROVIDER-MD-SOURCE-METADATA-01: add provider/source provenance metadata to canonical md_bars without changing the existing (symbol, timeframe, end_ts) primary key. Existing rows backfill provider_id='unknown'.

AUTON-NO-SIGNAL-OBS-01: add strategy_signal_evaluations durable journal table so a market-hours autonomous run that evaluates real bars but produces no order leaves durable evidence after daemon restart. Nullable run_id, no FK; observability only, not part of the outbox/inbox/run lifecycle chain.

AUTON-NO-TRADE-OFFHOURS-01B: add autonomous_no_trade_diagnostics durable snapshot table so the GET /api/v1/autonomous/readiness verdict (session window, arm/runtime-start state, overall_ready, dominant reason) survives a daemon restart instead of existing only as an in-memory/live-DB-read computation. Deterministic minute-bucketed UUIDv5 id bounds duplicate rows from frequent polling. Nullable run_id, no FK; observability only, not part of the outbox/inbox/run lifecycle chain. paper_order_attempted and live_order_attempted are always false.

PAPER-DAILY-PNL-BASELINE-01-COMBINED: add sys_account_equity_baseline table storing a provenance-tagged account-equity snapshot per trading_date (primary key), so GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary.daily_pnl can compare current equity against a real previous-session-close baseline instead of always returning null. No DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() — callers supply captured_at_utc and audit_event_id. No automatic capture mechanism is added by this migration or this patch group's Phase B/C — capture is explicitly deferred to a future patch.

STRATEGY-PROMOTION-REGISTRY-01B: add sys_strategy_promotion_transitions durable, append-only strategy paper-promotion registry (strategy_id + symbol + timeframe_secs identity; states shadow_approved/paper_approved/active_paper/demoted/retired/rejected; CHECK-constrained legal transition graph; evidence provenance columns; caller-injected transition_id/timestamps, no DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()). No mutable current-state row — current state is always a deterministic query over history. No backfill from sys_strategy_registry.enabled; table is empty after migration, meaning zero approved strategies.

STRATEGY-PROMOTION-REGISTRY-CLOSURE-REPAIR-01: add nullable parent_transition_id (self-referential FK) and evidence_transition_id (self-referential FK) columns to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions. parent_transition_id supports transactional concurrency serialization (mqk_db::insert_strategy_promotion_transition_serialized: pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed on identity, re-read-then-compare inside one transaction, stable transition_conflict rejection on a stale parent) so two concurrent transitions can never both be accepted as children of the same parent. evidence_transition_id supports durable evidence-lineage resolution (mqk_db::resolve_evidence_lineage) so any current state derived from a non-evidence-bearing transition (e.g. active_paper reached via paper_approved) can still be traced back to the exact evidence-bearing transition that authorized it. Both columns nullable (schema-safety only, no backfill decision required); the daemon route always populates both going forward. No existing column, row, or constraint altered.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01B-DURABLE-COORDINATION: add sys_autonomous_daily_operations (mutable current-state row, one per (market_date, deployment_mode, adapter_id) daily slot, CAS via state_version) and sys_autonomous_daily_operation_events (append-only transition history keyed (operation_id, transition_seq)). operation_id (UUIDv5 over six identity components, derived in mqk-daemon) is the primary key; the daily slot is a separate unique constraint, so a same-day identity mismatch is a typed conflict, never a second row or a silently rewritten identity field. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid()/fabricated numeric default on any not-null column -- every initial value (including state_version=1, start_attempt_count=0, bars_observed=0, bars_dispatched=0) is caller-supplied. Foundation only: no wiring into session_controller.rs, autonomous_bar_ticker.rs, the market-data scheduler, start_execution_runtime, any HTTP route, or any GUI component.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01B-BOUNDARY-MODEL-REPAIR-01: separate exchange-schedule truth from effective-autonomous-operation-window truth on sys_autonomous_daily_operations. Does not modify 0048. The pre-existing session_open_utc/session_close_utc columns remain physically present and are now explicitly documented (via COMMENT ON COLUMN) as the effective operation boundaries (mapped in Rust as effective_operation_open_utc/effective_operation_close_utc), never conflated with exchange truth. Adds nullable exchange_session_open_utc, exchange_session_close_utc, exchange_is_early_close, previous_trading_date columns carrying authoritative exchange-calendar facts, with a CHECK requiring all four present together or all four null (legacy-row compatibility only, no backfill), an exchange open-before-close CHECK, and a previous-trading-date-before-market-date CHECK. Every new row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies all four exchange fields as non-null.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01C-COMPLETED-BAR-DATA-DRIVER: add sys_autonomous_daily_bar_dispatches durable bar-identity-keyed dispatch claim table, additive, does not modify 0048/0049. Audit found no existing durable idempotency keyed on bar identity (symbol, timeframe, end_ts) anywhere in the native strategy dispatch/outbox path -- strategy_signal_evaluations dedupes on an arbitrary tick counter and oms_outbox dedupes on wall-clock now_micros, neither of which prevents re-dispatch of the same completed bar across a restart or retry. Primary key (operation_id, local_symbol, timeframe, bar_end_ts); status in ('claimed','completed','uncertain','failed'); foreign key to sys_autonomous_daily_operations with no destructive cascade (default NO ACTION). No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid()/fabricated default on any not-null column -- every value including claimed_at_utc is caller-supplied.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01D2-DURABLE-SESSION-COORDINATOR: add nullable stop_attempt_count/last_stop_attempt_utc columns to sys_autonomous_daily_operations, additive, does not modify 0048/0049/0050. Closes the durable stop-retry evidence gap: the existing schema had durable start-attempt evidence but nothing equivalent for the canonical stop_execution_runtime path. Legacy rows round-trip both columns as null (unknown history, never fabricated as zero); every row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies an explicit stop_attempt_count of 0 at insert time -- no SQL DEFAULT.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01D2-LIFECYCLE-CLOSURE-REPAIR-01: add nullable state_blocker_signature column to sys_autonomous_daily_operations, additive, does not modify 0048/0049/0050/0051. Closes a dedup-authority gap: state_reason_code alone cannot distinguish two distinct blocker occurrences sharing the same reason code. state_blocker_signature carries the D1 typed bounded blocker signature (sha256:<64 hex chars>) so dedup requires (state, state_reason_code, state_blocker_signature) together. Legacy rows round-trip as null (never fabricated); every new row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies an explicit null at insert time -- no SQL DEFAULT.

DURABLE-PAPER-PORTFOLIO-AND-PNL-01B-DURABLE-STORE: add sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots (append-only, deterministically-identified durable copy of an accepted authoritative broker account/position snapshot; source distinguishes 'external_alpaca' real truth from 'synthetic_diagnostic', never authoritative), sys_paper_portfolio_snapshot_positions (child rows, PK (snapshot_id, symbol)), and sys_paper_portfolio_accounting_state (one row per run_id, caching a replay of that run's already-durable oms_inbox applied fills through mqk-portfolio's FIFO engine -- not a second fill ledger; no fill content is duplicated, only the computed cash/realized-P&L/fees summary and the last_applied_inbox_id watermark that makes re-application idempotent). Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

DURABLE-PAPER-PORTFOLIO-AND-PNL-01-FINAL-RUN-SCOPING-ACCOUNTING-AND-CLOSURE-REPAIR: add nullable source_snapshot_id (self-referencing FK to sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots.snapshot_id) to sys_paper_portfolio_accounting_state, additive, does not modify 0053. Ties a durable accounting row to the exact broker snapshot whose positions were used to compute its accounting_epoch/accounting_epoch_reason, closing the cross-run/cross-snapshot provenance gap found in the Bundle 4 final closure review. Legacy rows round-trip source_snapshot_id as null (never backfilled/fabricated); a null value means completeness cannot be traced to a specific snapshot and must not be reported as fully proven active truth.

RUNTIME-OPPORTUNITY-ALLOCATION-01 Phase G: add sys_runtime_opportunity_allocation_plans (one durable row per allocation cycle, plan_id = the deterministic cycle_id, written only in shadow/paper_enforced mode -- the default off mode never writes here) and sys_runtime_opportunity_allocation_candidates (child rows, one per new/increasing-buy candidate considered; sell/reduce/exit/flatten decisions never appear here). Allocation evidence only -- never portfolio/P&L/order truth; equity_micros/source_snapshot_id are copied from the already-durable sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots row the cycle read, not a second NAV source. Scores/weights stored as scaled integers (x1,000,000), no binary float column. Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

MULTI-STRATEGY-CONFLICT-POLICY-01 Phase C: add sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_plans (one durable row per conflict-policy cycle, plan_id = the deterministic cycle_id, written only in shadow/paper_enforced mode -- the default off mode never writes here) and sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_candidates (child rows, one per candidate considered across every symbol group in the cycle, both buy and sell sides). Conflict-resolution evidence only -- never portfolio/P&L/order truth; records which exact original candidate (if any) was selected per symbol and why, never a rebuilt decision. Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

MULTI-STRATEGY-CONFLICT-POLICY-01-AUTHORITY-AND-EVIDENCE-REPAIR Defect 5: add nullable configured_mode to sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_plans (requested mode before the paper+Alpaca live-lock; mode remains the already-resolved effective mode) plus a plan_id=cycle_id consistency CHECK, and nullable order_type/time_in_force/limit_price/bar_present/bar_symbol/bar_strategy_id/bar_timeframe/close_micros to sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_candidates (full candidate bar provenance and order semantics, closing the 0056 gap where sell candidates carried no bar facts at all). Additive only, does not modify 0056. No backfill -- every 0056-era row round-trips the new columns as NULL and must be read as legacy/incomplete evidence, never fabricated or projected as active current truth.

DYNAMIC-STRATEGY-SYMBOL-SELECTION-01-FOUNDATION-AUTHORITY-CLOSURE-02 Defect B: add nullable evidence_fingerprint_v2 to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions, additive, does not modify 0046/0047. The legacy evidence_fingerprint hashes the matched review row after scanner_score has already been deserialized to f64, so two distinct raw decimal tokens can collide to the same legacy fingerprint while producing different exact Bundle 7 rankings. evidence_fingerprint_v2 is a versioned SHA-256 computed directly from the exact raw score token plus every other matched-row field affecting evidence identity. Legacy rows round-trip this column as NULL -- never backfilled from the mutable review-artifact filesystem at read time; Bundle 7's read-side validator refuses any identity lacking a v2 fingerprint with a distinct durable_fingerprint_v2_missing reason.

DYNAMIC-STRATEGY-SYMBOL-SELECTION-01-PHASE-7C Part 1: add sys_dynamic_selection_plans (one immutable durable row per resolved DynamicSelectionPlan, plan_id = the deterministic UUIDv5 derived from canonical_plan_identity_material, written only in shadow/paper_enforced mode -- off never writes here), sys_dynamic_selection_plan_symbols (one row per SymbolSelectionResult, always present even for a zero-candidate symbol, so symbol-level disposition/reason/exact_reason facts are never lost), and sys_dynamic_selection_plan_candidates (one row per SelectionCandidateResult, carrying every result-affecting evidence field canonical_plan_identity_material serializes) so Part 3's read-side validator can reconstruct the exact plan and independently recompute plan_id. approved_for_live is constrained false at the DB level. Selection-plan evidence only -- never portfolio/P&L/order/broker truth. Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

DYNAMIC-STRATEGY-SYMBOL-SELECTION-01-PHASE-7C-FORMAL-SOAK-GATE-TRUTH-REPAIR-01 Part 7: add a UNIQUE (plan_id, symbol, strategy_id, timeframe_secs) constraint to sys_dynamic_selection_plan_candidates. Migration 0059's only uniqueness constraint on that table was (plan_id, ordinal) -- physical insert-order identity, not the candidate's economic identity -- so a duplicate exact candidate key could previously be written under two different ordinals with no error. Additive only, does not modify 0059.

INGEST-JOB-CANCEL-STATUS-CONSTRAINT-REPAIR-01 (FULL-AUDIT-FAIL-012): replace sys_ingest_jobs_status_check (same constraint name) so it admits 'cancelled', matching IngestJobStatus::as_str()/from_str() exactly. Migration 0041 predates IngestJobStatus::Cancelled and the ingest-cancel route, so DB-backed cancellation was rejected by this constraint and returned 503 instead of 202. All previously-legal statuses are preserved unchanged. Additive only, does not modify 0041.

PAPER-SOAK-PARTIAL-FILL-DEDUP-01: add idx_inbox_run_order_event_kind on oms_inbox(run_id, internal_order_id, event_kind) to support the new economic-match lookup in inbox_insert_partial_fill_deduped (mqk-db::inbox), which checks for an existing partial_fill row with matching delta_qty/price_micros within a bounded event_ts_ms window before inserting -- closing the gap where migration 0040 fixed cross-lane WS/REST duplicate terminal fills but explicitly left partial fills uncovered. Purely additive index, no constraint or column change.

PAPER-SOAK-INBOUND-DRAIN-OWNERSHIP-01: add nullable runs.stop_requested_at_utc. Records that an operator stop was requested without changing runs.status away from RUNNING, so the orchestrator tick loop can suppress new outbox claim/dispatch (Phase 1) while continuing to run broker event fetch/ingest and inbound apply (Phase 2/3) until every broker-reachable order for the run has resolved to a terminal outcome -- closing the gap where stop_execution_runtime cleared local ownership unconditionally and the WS inbound transport (gated on local ownership) then silently dropped any late fill/cancel/reject frame with zero logging. Additive only, no constraint change.

PRE-SOAK-DAEMON-SUPERVISOR-HALT-FENCE-CLOSURE-01: add 'ExecutionLoopTickFailure' to the sys_arm_state.reason CHECK constraint so mqk-daemon's execution-loop supervisor generic tick-error fallback (persist_execution_loop_safety_halt) can durably disarm through halt_and_disarm_run_if_active instead of failing the fenced halt write with a constraint violation. Additive only, no other constraint or column change.

PROMOTION-WALKFORWARD-GATE-WIRING-01-REPAIR-CLOSURE: add nullable research_trial_id/research_economic_eval_id/research_deflated_sharpe_ratio/research_probability_backtest_overfitting/backtest_run_id to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions, closing the missing-durable-Research-lineage gap independent review of 242cb7c3 found (DSR/PBO were only ever logged, never persisted) and adding the first durable pointer to canonical Backtest evidence (PROMOTION-BACKTEST-EVIDENCE-SEAM-01's run_id). Identity pointers and judged statistics only, never a copy of underlying artifact bytes. Additive only, no existing column or constraint from 0046/0047/0058 altered.

PROMOTION-EVIDENCE-LINEAGE-V3: add nullable research_judge_artifact_sha256/stress_protocol_version/stress_artifact_sha256/robustness_protocol_version/finalized_robustness_artifact_sha256/promotion_policy_fingerprint to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions, extending migration 0065's identity-pointer lineage so a transition can later prove the EXACT evidence judged (which judge artifact, which stress/robustness protocol and artifact content hash, which promotion-policy thresholds) rather than only which trial/run. Every hash reuses an existing accepted audit hash already computed and verified elsewhere in the evidence chain, except promotion_policy_fingerprint (genuinely new -- PromotionConfig was never durably hashed before). Additive only, no existing column or constraint from 0046/0047/0058/0065 altered.

DYNAMIC-SELECTION-CONFIG-ELIGIBILITY-CLOSURE-01: add nullable config_identity_verified/durable_config_fingerprint/current_config_fingerprint to sys_dynamic_selection_plan_candidates, extending migration 0059's evidence-store schema to carry the config-identity gate result (reuses the same canonical config-identity comparison mechanism C1/C2/R2 already established, never a new parallel policy). A NULL config_identity_verified on a pre-migration row reads back fail-closed as false, never optimistically verified. Additive only, no existing column or constraint from 0059/0060 altered.

RUNTIME-LEASE-RUN-IDENTITY-AUTHORITY-01: add nullable runtime_leader_lease.run_id (references runs(run_id) on delete cascade) so the single global leadership lease row is durably bound to the run it was acquired for, closing the confirmed defect where acquire_or_refresh_lease_for_running_run could only judge steal-eligibility by raw TTL expiry and had no way to distinguish an orphaned different-run lease (left behind because stop_run_if_evidence_clean does not delete it) from the same run's own prior lease -- a brand-new run's fresh heartbeat was being read as evidence about a completely different, older run's holder. run_id is nullable: no backfill decision is required for the at-most-one pre-existing row (mirrors migration 0067's precedent); a legacy run_id-IS-NULL row is treated as an anonymous lease under the pre-migration fail-closed contract and is naturally replaced by a proper run_id-bound row on the next successful acquisition. ON DELETE CASCADE: production never deletes a runs row, but disposable test fixtures across the workspace do, and a lease bound to a deleted run carries no remaining authority. Additive only, no existing column or constraint altered.

RUNTIME-LEASE-LEGACY-UNBOUND-MIGRATION-SAFETY-01: repairs 0068's compatibility design, which treated a run_id-IS-NULL runtime_leader_lease row as raw-TTL-expiry-only reclaimable -- unsafe because the pre-0068 lease TTL (90s) is smaller than the deadman TTL (120s), so a legacy NULL lease could be raw-expired while its (unknowable) owning run remained deadman-healthy. Under an advisory quiescence gate (fails closed if the row is still lease-unexpired, or if any run reports ARMED status or deadman-fresh RUNNING status while the row is raw-expired -- `LOCK TABLE runs IN SHARE MODE` prevents a concurrent run-start/status-change from racing the check), any existing run_id-IS-NULL row is deleted as provably non-authoritative; run_id stays nullable because the crate's legacy non-run-aware acquire_lease/refresh_lease primitives (no production call site) still write NULL. Also changes runtime_leader_lease_run_id_fkey from ON DELETE CASCADE to ON DELETE RESTRICT: no test in the workspace both binds the lease to a run and deletes that run, so CASCADE's stated justification never applied, and RESTRICT is the correct fail-closed production invariant (a run a lease still points to carries live authority and must not be silently destroyed by deleting the run).

RUNTIME-LEASE-STRICT-QUIESCENCE-FORWARD-01: forward-only repair for the deployed immutable 0069 migration. If a run_id-IS-NULL runtime_leader_lease row exists, refuse while that lease is unexpired or while any run reports ARMED or RUNNING status regardless of heartbeat freshness; LOCK TABLE runs IN SHARE MODE fences concurrent run-status mutation across the check/delete. Delete the ambiguous legacy row only when the system is quiescent. No FK/schema change is repeated here; 0069 already established ON DELETE RESTRICT.

MULTI-STRATEGY-RUNTIME-DISPATCH-01 / autonomous completed-bar driver multi-binding repair (R2A, V4-STAGE-B-M2-REPAIR-02): new additive table sys_autonomous_daily_binding_state, keyed per-binding (operation_id, symbol, strategy_id, timeframe) -- distinct from migration 0050's per-bar sys_autonomous_daily_bar_dispatches. Durably records whether each configured binding is 'active' (progress-capable) or 'locally_blocked' (a binding-local fault quarantines only that binding, per the frozen hybrid per-binding fault-isolation operator decision), with a closed reason-code vocabulary. No existing table/column altered.

MULTI-STRATEGY-RUNTIME-DISPATCH-01 Patch C2 (V4-STAGE-B-M2-REPAIR-03): two new additive tables, sys_explicit_multi_strategy_authority and sys_explicit_multi_strategy_authority_bindings, for the explicit watchlist-v3 per-symbol multi-strategy authorization mechanism's durable evidence -- deliberately separate from sys_dynamic_selection_plans/* (0059/0060), which represents one Bundle 7 ranking plan, never this mechanism. authority_id is a caller-minted deterministic UUIDv5 binding every result-affecting input (run_id, source artifact identity/hash, config fingerprint, market_date, per-binding evidence); approved_for_live is constrained false at the DB level; a UNIQUE(authority_id, symbol, strategy_id, timeframe_secs) constraint on the bindings table enforces that the exact same binding can never appear twice under one authority. No existing table/column altered.

MULTI-STRATEGY-RUNTIME-DISPATCH-01 (V4-STAGE-B-M2-C1-C3-REPAIR-04 Patch D2): add every previously-omitted mqk_portfolio::SelectionCandidateEvidence field to sys_explicit_multi_strategy_authority_bindings (promotion_expired, evidence_resolved, review_state_is_paper_candidate, evidence_review_state, durable/recomputed legacy and v2 fingerprints plus their match flags, plugin_instantiable, timeframe_matches, canonical_score_decimal/micros, scanner_rank, watchlist_assigned, evidence_review_id/scanner_scan_id/artifact_path/git_hash, promotion_effective_at/expires_at, exact_reason) so every result-affecting field can be durably persisted and bound into authority_id. Additive only -- 0072 is not modified; every new column is nullable-or-defaulted.

MULTI-STRATEGY-RUNTIME-DISPATCH-01 autonomous completed-bar driver multi-binding repair (R2B, V4-BULK-CODE-COMPLETION-STAGE-B-M2-01 C4): widen 0071's closed sys_autonomous_daily_binding_state_reason_known vocabulary (drop+re-add by the same constraint name, idempotent) with one new value, binding_strategy_engine_not_active, covering a configured multi-symbol binding whose strategy_id does not match the process's one active native-strategy engine (Tier A single-strategy policy) -- a real binding-local fault none of 0071's original five reasons describe honestly. Additive only -- 0071's table/columns are unchanged.

MULTI-STRATEGY-RUNTIME-DISPATCH-01 autonomous completed-bar driver same-symbol multi-strategy repair (V4-BULK-CODE-COMPLETION-STAGE-B-M2-01, correcting the prior session's C4 patch): new additive table sys_autonomous_daily_binding_bar_dispatches, keyed (operation_id, symbol, strategy_id, timeframe, bar_end_ts) -- distinct from migration 0050's sys_autonomous_daily_bar_dispatches (no strategy_id; correct and unchanged for the legacy single-engine path only). Required because an approved watchlist-v3 fleet can bind two different strategies to the same (symbol, timeframe) (e.g. AAPL/strategy_A and AAPL/strategy_B), which 0050's identity cannot distinguish. Used exclusively by the new host-pool dispatch route in autonomous_completed_bar_driver.rs. No existing table/column altered.

CUTOVER-1D-A1: add an explicit qty_micros_v1 evidence encoding to Bundle 5 runtime opportunity-allocation candidates and Bundle 6 runtime strategy-conflict candidates without reinterpreting historical whole-unit bigint values. Historical rows retain quantity_schema_version=NULL and legacy quantity columns; new CUTOVER-1D writers will set quantity_schema_version=qty_micros_v1, write only *_qty_micros quantity authority, and leave legacy quantity columns NULL. CHECK constraints make the two encodings mutually exclusive. No historical row is rescaled; no trading authority, risk policy, order sizing, Paper/Live state, broker routing, or execution capability is changed by this migration.

CUTOVER-1D-A3: add an explicit qty_micros_v1 encoding to the durable strategy_signal_evaluations journal (quantity_schema_version + signal_qty_micros) so a successfully evaluated fractional signal is never journaled as an absent quantity. Historical rows retain quantity_schema_version=NULL and the whole-unit signal_qty column, unrescaled; new evaluated rows write raw QtyMicros in signal_qty_micros with signal_qty NULL. A CHECK constraint makes the two encodings mutually exclusive. No trading authority, risk policy, order sizing, Paper/Live state, broker routing, or execution capability is changed by this migration.

M5/M6 asset-neutral quantity: add an explicit qty_micros_v1 encoding to sys_paper_portfolio_snapshot_positions (quantity_schema_version + qty_signed_micros; qty_signed becomes nullable) so a fractional (Crypto) broker position is stored exactly instead of refusing the whole durable snapshot. Historical rows retain quantity_schema_version=NULL and the whole-unit qty_signed column, unrescaled; whole-unit positions (all Equity) continue to be written in that historical encoding; only a fractional position writes qty_signed_micros with qty_signed NULL. No trading authority, risk policy, order sizing, Paper/Live state, broker routing, or execution capability is changed by this migration.

D6/A5, D7: add an explicit qty_micros_v1 encoding to fill_quality_telemetry (quantity_schema_version + ordered_qty_micros + fill_qty_micros; ordered_qty/fill_qty become nullable, fill_qty's own > 0 check replaced by the combined encoding CHECK) so a genuinely fractional Crypto fill is captured exactly instead of being silently skipped entirely (mqk_runtime::orchestrator::fill_quality::build_fill_quality_row previously returned None for a fractional order/fill). Historical rows retain quantity_schema_version=NULL and the whole-unit ordered_qty/fill_qty columns, unrescaled -- there is no historical fractional row to reconcile since the prior code path wrote nothing for one; the historical gap is a genuine absence of telemetry, not a truncated value, and stays UNKNOWN. Two CHECK constraints make the fill-side and order-side encodings mutually exclusive/well-formed. D1, B1: add execution_domain (equity_nyse | crypto_24_7) to sys_autonomous_daily_operations' daily-slot identity -- the unique (market_date, deployment_mode, adapter_id) anchor becomes unique (market_date, deployment_mode, adapter_id, execution_domain) so both domains can run independently for the same broker/deployment/day without colliding on one applicable-operation slot. Every historical row is deterministically classified equity_nyse (proven, not guessed: the Alpaca adapter's supports_asset_class(Crypto) has never returned true in any shipped commit, so no historical operation could have been crypto_24_7); the column's DEFAULT is dropped immediately after backfilling existing rows so every future insert must supply it explicitly. No production runtime-ownership/lease wiring is added by this migration -- see B1 disposition in the mission ledger for what remains open (per-domain lease/runtime ownership, B2/B3, is out of scope for this patch).

B2 (part 1 of the domain-keyed runtime/lease ownership migration): add execution_domain (equity_nyse | crypto_24_7) to `runs` identity so the single-active-run gate (fetch_active_run_for_engine/fetch_latest_run_for_engine) can be scoped per (engine_id, mode, execution_domain) instead of per (engine_id, mode) alone -- the structural prerequisite for equity_nyse and crypto_24_7 to each hold an independent, coexisting durable run. Every historical row is deterministically classified equity_nyse (identical proof to migration 0080: supports_asset_class(Crypto) has never returned true in any shipped commit); the column's DEFAULT is dropped immediately after backfill so every future insert must supply it explicitly. This migration only widens run identity -- the runtime_leader_lease table, in-memory AppState runtime ownership, and control-route/coordinator threading are separate B2 patches.

B2.2 (second half of the domain-keyed runtime/lease ownership prerequisite): domain-key `runtime_leader_lease`. Row identity moves from the meaningless global singleton `id = 1` to the natural `execution_domain` key (equity_nyse | crypto_24_7), so each domain's runtime can hold its own independent, coexisting leadership lease instead of contending for one global row. The pre-existing row (if any) is deterministically classified equity_nyse (same proof as 0080/0081); the old CHECK(id=1) singleton constraint and the now-redundant `id` column are dropped (identified by constraint definition text, not a guessed auto-generated name; confirmed no other table's foreign key references `runtime_leader_lease.id`). mqk-db's lease API (runtime_lease.rs), the two runs.rs recovery paths that read/clear this table (clear_halted_run_and_reset_stale_claims, stop_run_if_evidence_clean), and orders.rs's fenced outbox claim (outbox_claim_batch_for_run_with_lease_authority) are updated in the same patch to resolve execution_domain from the run's own durable identity rather than accepting it from a caller, so no dual (old-singleton, new-domain-keyed) authority path exists at any point.

B6: durable, restart-safe, deduplicated Crypto fee-activity ingestion. Two additive tables, neither pre-existing. sys_crypto_fee_activity_ledger: one immutable row per Alpaca CFEE/FEE account activity ever ingested, keyed by Alpaca's own activity_id (PRIMARY KEY) so a duplicate fetch/retry/restart can insert with ON CONFLICT (activity_id) DO NOTHING -- no duplicate charge is possible at the DB level. attribution_status mirrors mqk-broker-alpaca::fee_attribution::FeeAttributionRecord's three shapes (cash_fee / asset_denominated_fee_unsupported / confirmed_zero_fee) with a CHECK enforcing exactly one payload field (fee_micros xor qty_raw xor neither) per shape; this is fee-activity evidence only, never written as a fill. sys_crypto_fee_ingestion_cursor: one row per (engine_id, mode, activity_type) recording the last successfully ingested activity_id -- the restart-safe watermark fetch_fee_activities_since(after_id) resumes from, advanced only in the same transaction as its corresponding ledger rows. No production caller wired in this patch -- Crypto capability remains default off (D2/B4); this is the durable evidence layer a future ingestion-loop caller requires before it could exist safely.

D1: durable, restart-safe, deduplicated options lifecycle activity ingestion. Per Alpaca's official docs, exercise/assignment/expiration are reported as three distinct non-trade activities (OPEXC/OPASN/OPEXP, each net_amount=0); the actual underlying-share delivery and strike cash consideration for OPEXC/OPASN is reported via a separate same-day paired OPTRD trade activity. sys_option_lifecycle_activity_ledger stores each of the four raw activity types as its own evidence row keyed by Alpaca's own activity_id (PRIMARY KEY, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING dedup, mirrors migration 0083's activity_id contract exactly); a CHECK constraint enforces exactly OPTRD carries a price. sys_option_lifecycle_ingestion_cursor is the restart-safe per-(engine_id,mode,activity_type) watermark. sys_option_lifecycle_applied is a separate idempotent-apply marker (D2): one row per lifecycle activity_id whose PairedLifecycleEffect (mqk_portfolio::option_lifecycle) has already been durably applied -- re-attempting apply for an already-applied activity_id is a checked no-op. No production caller wired in this patch -- Alpaca options capability does not exist in this codebase yet; this is the durable evidence layer a future ingestion/apply caller requires before it could exist safely.
